title: 2022 Member of National Assembly results, Nairobi City
note: Public provisional figures for each constituency, every candidate, not yet checked against IEBC's Forms 35B. Loaded where the list matches IEBC's candidate list in full, with valid as the candidates' total, and for Dagoretti North and South, where one minor candidate is missing, without a valid total. Not loaded for Kasarani (3 of 14 candidates, the runner-up under another party than the press and IEBC's list give), Ruaraka (3 of 9, without UDA's) or Embakasi East (2 of 5); Embakasi North had no figures. On the leaders they agree with The Star, Citizen Digital and The Standard in nine seats; they give Roysambu's runner-up 40,381 where the Daily Nation printed 40,140.
